responsibility: This header defines GCC’s primary templated vector container API. It provides the vec family for heap- and GGC-backed dynamic arrays in pointer and embedded layouts, the inline operations for growth, access, insertion, removal, searching, sorting, and release, plus related helpers such as array_slice and release_vec_vec, making it the standard resizable-sequence abstraction used throughout the compiler.
same_name_distinction: Defines the primary vec template family, allocation/layout variants, inline element operations, and helpers like array_slice; the same-stem .cc file is reserved for out-of-line support code such as statistics, allocation heuristics, comparator checking, and selftests.
